name: v0.23.0
body:
## Co-op Translator 0.23.0

This release makes large multilingual translation runs safer and easier to automate, adds custom output directories and configurable text concurrency, improves multilingual documentation navigation, and fixes root-relative links to untranslated files.

### Highlights

- Added translation plans, machine-readable progress events, verification reports, stable exit codes, context files, and include/exclude controls for CI systems and coding agents.
- Added `--translations-dir` so the CLI can write translations to custom locations such as `docs/i18n`.
- Added configurable text translation concurrency through `--concurrency` and the Python API while preserving sequential execution by default.
- Added Agent Skill and plugin distribution assets for agent-assisted repository translation workflows.
- Improved onboarding and GitHub Pages navigation, synchronized documentation across 54 languages, and added source-heading aliases for translated pages.
- Fixed root-relative links to untranslated files so they resolve against the project root, while preserving protocol-relative external URLs.

## What's Changed

- Docs: Improve onboarding and GitHub Pages navigation by @skytin1004 in #553
- Docs: Sync translations for 54 languages and fix translated page anchors by @skytin1004 in #557
- Core: Support custom translation directories in the CLI by @skytin1004 in #554
- Core: Add configurable text translation concurrency by @skytin1004 in #555
- Docs: Add agent skill and plugin distribution by @skytin1004 in #556
- Core: Add agent-safe translation planning and verification by @skytin1004 in #558
- Core: Resolve root-relative links to untranslated files against the project root by @xThreeh in #560
- Build: Bump version to 0.23.0 by @skytin1004 in #563

## New Contributors

- Welcome @xThreeh, who made their first contribution in #560!

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/compare/v0.22.0...v0.23.0
